scope: Independent read-only source review; no network, device I/O or provision execution

findings.detail: Require matching first/second length words in 8..65535 before CRC/token parsing.
Persist stage token before mkdir; uncertain begin failures retain explicit remote_lock_may_remain rather than falsely report no lock.

reviewed_contracts: Fixed exact four write extents; original stock slot2/code/device identity and mandatory mounted filesystems checked before mutation
Backup entries/header then primary entries/header; full source staging hash, dd fsync and exact readback; other GPT copy valid before each write
Unknown write outcome never retried or automatically recovered; durable host backup and explicit subsequent reviewed recovery
Stock SSH uses bounded <=16KiB stdin only to fresh private staging files, not directly to block device; noclobber, source metadata/hash then separate dd regular file
Explicit recovery retains recognized valid GPT copy first
limitations: No physical eMMC/power-loss or SSH execution acceptance from this source review.
Recovery intentionally refuses if kernel already enumerated p11 after reboot; requires separate read-only consumer/mount assessment before any broader recovery procedure.
Remote lock is a cooperative exclusion marker, not proof unrelated root firmware writers are absent.
